description: React component for managing and displaying a list of groups in the Mattermost admin console, including filtering, pagination, and group linking/unlinking actions.

classes.name: GroupsList
classes.description: React component class for listing and managing groups with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: closeFilters
methods.description: Closes the filter dropdown menu.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial LDAP groups when component mounts.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the previous page.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the next page.

methods.name: onCheckToggle
methods.description: Toggles the checked state of a group.

methods.name: linkSelectedGroups
methods.description: Links selected groups that are not yet linked.

methods.name: unlinkSelectedGroups
methods.description: Unlinks selected groups that are currently linked.

methods.name: selectionActionButtonType
methods.description: Determines the type of action button ('link', 'unlink', 'disabled') based on selection.

methods.name: renderSelectionActionButton
methods.description: Renders the action button for linking or unlinking groups.

methods.name: renderHeader
methods.description: Renders the header row of the groups list.

methods.name: renderRows
methods.description: Renders the list of group rows or loading/error messages.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Creates a case-insensitive regex from a string.

methods.name: searchGroups
methods.description: Performs a search/filter on groups based on search string and filters.

methods.name: handleGroupSearchKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events in the search input, triggers search on Enter.

methods.name: newSearchString
methods.description: Updates the search string based on filter toggle.

methods.name: handleFilterCheck
methods.description: Updates filter states and triggers search.

methods.name: renderSearchFilters
methods.description: Renders the filter options UI.

methods.name: resetFiltersAndSearch
methods.description: Resets all filters and performs a fresh search.

methods.name: handleGetGroupsResponse
methods.description: Handles the response from LDAP groups fetch, updates error/loading states.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, including search, filters, list, and pagination.
